scope.beginning: The episode begins when Cronus learns that one of his children is fated to overthrow him.
scope.ending: It ends with Rhea grieving the swallowed children and seeking a way to save the next birth.

characters.goal: prevent a child from replacing him

narrative.synopsis: Cronus repeats the logic of succession fear by swallowing each child Rhea bears. Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, and Poseidon disappear into him, but Rhea’s grief turns toward rescue.
narrative.openingSituation: Cronus rules after overthrowing Uranus but fears suffering the same fate.
narrative.centralConflict: Each birth threatens his throne, and each act of swallowing deepens Rhea’s desperation.
narrative.resolution: The older children are trapped alive inside Cronus.
narrative.outcome: Rhea is driven to protect Zeus before Cronus can swallow him too.

events.consequence: Cronus fears the prophecy attached to his children.
Rhea begins bearing the future Olympians.
The swallowed children continue hidden inside him.
Rhea turns toward a plan for the next child.
